motive.zhHans: 从逻辑上讲，坠落产生的力量并不会致人死亡。阿笠博士随后揭示了可以证实 Tsukasa 实施杀人的证据：要使书架倒塌，必须施加相当大的力量；因此，必然会留下痕迹。他杀害 Naoto 的原因是——Naoto 不仅勒索了 Daigo，还勒索了 Tsukasa。由于他没有钱购买更昂贵的，他决定在夜间偷一些。事后 Tsukasa 跪下，感到相当后悔，因为阿笠给他上了一课：纸牌游戏可以重来，人的生命却不能。
motive.en: Since the strength from the fall would not cause a person to die, logically speaking. Professor Agasa then revealed the evidence that may verify Tsukasa carrying out the murder: in order to make a bookshelf collapse, considerable strength must be applied; therefore, traces are bound to be left. The reason that he murdered Naoto was because that - not only did Naoto blackmail Daigo, but also Tsukasa. Since he didn't have money to purchase more expensive ones, he decided to steal some at nighttime. Aftermath Tsukasa kneeled down and felt rather regretful, since Agasa had taught him a lesson: A card game can be played over again, but human life cannot be.

method.zhHans: 机械装置 Tsukasa 为启动这个手法所走的对角线路径。Tsukasa 用一根尼龙绳实施杀人；他把绳子的一端固定在自己腰带的后侧，事先将另一端绕过那座倒塌书架顶部的钉子。
method.en: The Mechanical Gimmick The diagonal path that Tsukasa took to activate the trick. Tsukasa used a string of nylon to carry out the murder; he fixed one end of the string to the back of his belt, passing the other end over the nail on the top of that collapsed bookshelf beforehand.

evidence.zhHans: 证据与动机 然而，Naoto 并非因倒塌的书架而死。阿笠博士随后揭示了可以证实 Tsukasa 实施杀人的证据：要使书架倒塌，必须施加相当大的力量；因此，必然会留下痕迹。另一项证据是留在 Tsukasa 裤子上的血迹。警方对 Tsukasa 的裤子做了鲁米诺测试，发现了血迹。
evidence.en: The Evidence and Motive Nevertheless, Naoto did not die due to the fallen bookshelf. Professor Agasa then revealed the evidence that may verify Tsukasa carrying out the murder: in order to make a bookshelf collapse, considerable strength must be applied; therefore, traces are bound to be left. Another piece of evidence would be the blood that remained on Tsukasa's trousers. The police did a luminol test on Tsukasa's trousers and found the blood stains.

resolution.zhHans: 通过阿笠博士，柯南得以传达出犯人就是 Tsukasa Nitta。
resolution.en: Via Professor Agasa, Conan was able to convey that the culprit is Tsukasa Nitta.

summary.en: Within a certain bookstore, the Detective Boys were playing trading cards - Mitsuhiko was having a confrontation with Genta. While they play, Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, and Professor Agasa were watching nearby. On the other side of the table, stood two mystical people... also watching their games in silence.

suspects: Tsukasa Nitta, Daigo Zaizen and Osamu Kuno
suspectsZh: 新田司、财前大悟与久野修
